description: This Java source file defines the MockIASSensor class, a mock implementation of a Zigbee sensor device with various clusters and sensor functionalities, used for testing or simulation purposes.

classes.name: MockIASSensor
classes.description: A mock sensor device class simulating a Zigbee sensor with multiple clusters for testing purposes.

methods.name: MockIASSensor
methods.description: Constructs a new MockIASSensor with specified name, EUI64, and zone cluster type.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Sets the low battery status on the zone cluster.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Returns whether the sensor has a low battery.

methods.name: setBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Sets the battery voltage on the zone cluster.

methods.name: getBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Retrieves the battery voltage from the zone cluster.

methods.name: setFaulted
methods.description: Sets the faulted status on the zone cluster.

methods.name: isFaulted
methods.description: Returns whether the zone is faulted.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Checks if the sensor has been tampered.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tampered status on the zone cluster.

methods.name: setMeasuredTemperature
methods.description: Sets the measured temperature in the temperature measurement cluster.

methods.name: getMeasuredTemperature
methods.description: Gets the measured temperature from the temperature measurement cluster.

methods.name: isTroubled
methods.description: Checks if the zone is troubled.

methods.name: setTroubled
methods.description: Sets the troubled status on the zone cluster.

methods.name: sendCheckIn
methods.description: Sends a check-in signal via the poll control cluster.

methods.name: sendComcastCheckIn
methods.description: Sends a Comcast-specific check-in with detailed parameters.
